name: pi-ai-extra
description: Registry-free pnpm workspace for KIE, ToAPIs and Gemini image/chat extensions to pi-ai

scripts.check: pnpm --recursive --workspace-concurrency=1 run check && pnpm run check:docs
scripts.check:docs: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && tsc --noEmit -p docs/migration/open-graph-single && tsc --noEmit -p docs/migration/auto-og && tsc --noEmit -p docs/migration/infocard
scripts.playground: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @hk01/pi-ai-extra-playground run start
